title: Protrixplus TradingView Webhook Envelope
description: FROZEN wire contract v1.0. The stored backend strategy configuration is always authoritative. Message-supplied values such as master_lot_info are informational only and MUST NOT be used for sizing or risk.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version. Frozen at 1.0 for S0.

signal_id.description: Producer-assigned unique id for this signal. Basis of idempotent acceptance.

event_time_utc.description: ISO-8601 timestamp in UTC. Must carry an explicit UTC offset (Z or +00:00). The regex is the portable rule; format:date-time is belt-and-braces.

position_ref.description: REQUIRED for management actions (CLOSE, PARTIAL_CLOSE, MODIFY_SLTP, EMERGENCY_CLOSE). Identifies the master position this command targets.

close_fraction.description: Decimal fraction in (0,1] as a JSON string to preserve precision. Only meaningful for PARTIAL_CLOSE.

stop_loss.description: Price as a decimal string. Never a JSON number (float precision loss).

take_profit.description: Price as a decimal string. Never a JSON number (float precision loss).

master_lot_info.description: INFORMATIONAL ONLY. Never authoritative for sizing. The stored strategy_assignment.master_lot is the source of truth.
